continuity_scope: Delimited textual-witness pass; not a claim to exhaust Greek regional, ritual, artistic, or later literary traditions.
omissions: Most named Olympians and Titans not needed for this bounded pass
Nymphs, mortal genealogies, local heroes, cult figures, and most monsters
Regional variants; vase/iconographic evidence; lyric, Hellenistic, Roman, and Byzantine receptions
Tragedies and epic cycles beyond the named works, except the Oedipus at Colonus locator explicitly noted in two records
uncertainties: Ancient Greek myth has variant genealogies, motives, divine jurisdictions, and characterizations; this pass preserves selected-witness provenance rather than reconciling them.
'Pseudo-Apollodorus' is conventional modern attribution for the Library; the record retains the work title rather than treating authorship as certain.
Some modern comparison IDs are intentionally blank where a mapping would distort a source-native ontology.
evidence_basis: Every character and relationship is tied to a primary-text locator in a scholarly digital repository. URLs identify the edition/repository; locators identify the precise book, hymn, or line range.

supports: Hesiodic Theogony is a named witness in the pass and illustrates the primary-text repository basis.
